title: Are we in control of our decisions? | Dan Ariely
summary: In a TED talk, behavioral economist Dan Ariely uses visual illusions and his research to show that people are less rational in their decisions than they think. He covers defaults, such as organ donation rates, and how choice framing steers decisions.
why: Used to illustrate predictable irrationality, such as defaults and the effect of the middle option among three choices.

quote.text: talks about the very significant differences in organ donation rates between countries
